items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who did Staggs work with down here? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No. Do you know Judy? ... He went all through all in Spain, London, all that.

ctx.x: Because he was there with client's wedding. And I say, he's dead. Some of them know him, but he played it by a dead, that if they say, he's so close to him. He's dead. Some of them know him, but he's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. Some of them know him, but he's dead. Some of them know him, but he's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. He's dead. Well, then they know we, you see? That's the way we do the metal…
Who did Staggs work with down here? Did he have Italian ponds?
No. Do you know Judy? From Trumpet? No, drummer. No. He went all through all in Spain, London, all that. That baby's back over here now. He lives down in New York and Chicago.
